ambiguities.source_text: Some input files contain an "Additonal Metrics" section (with a typo in the original spelling). Exclude all rows from the "Additonal Metrics" section onward when processing the data. Only process rows that appear before this section marker.

ambiguities.intent: Divide percent targets greater than one by 100.
